note: Both sets read the values, units and quotes correctly, and both bind them to the right components. Set A additionally captures the driveshaft structural-damping ratio of 5% critical with its free-free-mode condition, which Set B omits entirely. Set A's extra coverage comes at the cost of two duplicate pairs (the driveshaft spring constant and the generator inertia each appear twice, once from the prose and once from Table 5-1), so it is somewhat redundant but factually richer.
remarks: Both sets state the same facts twice via prose and Table 5-1 under slightly different names (e.g. 'Rated Generator Speed' vs 'rated generator speed'); Set A does this for two facts it happens to include twice explicitly. Neither set captures the driveshaft natural frequency (stated only as 'same as the RECOFF turbine model', no value) or the DOWEC-derived brake torque ratio, which is reasonable since no numeric value is given on the page.
